review.method: automated-independent-model-visual-review

source_contract.intent: Chinese reaction meme featuring a cartoon person with a black bowl-cut hairstyle, raised bent arms, and a smug smiling human face. The single visible face is the editable image slot for replacing the expression with the user's own photo. The bottom caption reads “我就是这么强大” (“I am just this powerful”).
source_contract.reason: A humorous face-only-plus-caption reaction meme with one independent visible face; the original expression may be intentionally replaced.

reviews.reason: The original human face is completely replaced by the cat image in all edit columns, leaving no trace of the original features. The caption is correctly removed in the 'EMPTY TEXT' column and replaced with '新表情' in the 'NEW TEXT' and 'CUTOUT INPUT' columns. Character props like the black bowl-cut hair and muscular arms are perfectly preserved.

primary_visual_review.reason: All five diagnostic columns are visually complete and consistent with the single editable face plus one bottom caption. The original human face is fully replaced by the licensed cat photograph in the source face location, with no retained eyes or mouth, while the bowl-cut hair, ears, raised bent arms, clothing, body, and fixed scenery remain intact. The original caption is completely removed in the EMPTY TEXT column and fully replaced in the REPLACED, NEW TEXT, and CUTOUT INPUT columns; the replacement caption is complete and legible. Uploaded-photo background inside the face mask is acceptable under the stated template behavior. The source is static, so there is no motion loss, and the diagnostic columns are comparisons rather than extra panels.

The user can replace the expression with their own photo while the character’s hair, clothing, pose, and limbs remain fixed. The original caption reads “全都一起上吧” (“Everyone, come at me together”).
source_contract.reason: The source has one independent main visible reaction face intended for photo replacement, plus one complete original caption block. No animated frames, logos, UI captures, or unrelated news content are present.

reviews.reason: All steps of the image editing pipeline are executed correctly across the columns: the original face (eyes, pupils, and mouth) is completely removed in the replacement, the original caption has been properly replaced with the new text '新表情', the character's hair, clothing, and martial arts pose are fully preserved without distortion, and the cutout matches the expected localized composition.

primary_visual_review.reason: All five diagnostic columns are complete and preserve the single-panel composition, pose, hair, clothing, limbs, and fixed scenery. The original human face is fully removed and replaced by the uploaded cat photograph within the intended face region without covering the hands or other props. The source caption is fully intact in the source and replaced columns; the empty-text column correctly removes every editable caption line with no residual letters or outlines; and the changed-text columns display the complete replacement text “新表情”. The static source has no animation to lose.
